title: PaintEye
shortDescription: A modern color analytics and architectural paint visualizer powered by Next.js App Router, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL with RGB/HEX spectral mapping.
overview: PaintEye is an advanced web application designed for interior designers, architects, and paint specialists. It delivers instant color palette extraction from user-uploaded room photos, simulates realistic ambient lighting transformations, and provides real-time catalog search backed by Prisma ORM and PostgreSQL with indexed CIE-Lab color distance matching.
problem: Selecting paint colors from digital screens often fails in practice because standard RGB displays ignore ambient lighting shifts, surface undertones, and paint finish reflectance, leading to costly repainting projects.
solution: Engineered an intelligent Next.js platform that analyzes uploaded room imagery, extracts dominant chromatic clusters using color quantization, matches them against manufacturer catalog databases, and simulates lighting temperature variations.

features.title: Intelligent Palette Extraction
features.description: Runs in-browser image quantization to isolate primary, secondary, and accent colors without server load.

features.title: Relational Color Distance Engine
features.description: Custom PostgreSQL queries with CIE-Lab mathematical distance calculations to find nearest commercial manufacturer paint matches.

features.title: Ambient Light Simulation
features.description: Interactive slider simulating Kelvin temperatures from 2700K (warm dawn) to 6500K (cool daylight) on room surfaces.

features.title: Project Moodboard Exporter
features.description: Generates exportable client spec sheets containing paint codes, finish recommendations, and complementary trim palettes.

contributions: Designed the relational database schema in Prisma ORM with optimized indexes for RGB and CIE-Lab coordinate queries.
Built the full Next.js App Router application with responsive layouts, modal overlays, and server-side data fetching.
Developed a custom color segmentation algorithm that isolates room boundaries based on edge detection.
Implemented structured JSON REST endpoints for catalog filtering, brand comparisons, and user swatch collections.

challenges.title: Accurate Color Representation Across Lighting Shifts
challenges.challenge: Translating sRGB values to perceived physical paint tones under varying color temperatures required mathematical corrections.
challenges.solution: Integrated colorimetric conversion algorithms (sRGB → XYZ → CIE-L*a*b*) and applied Kelvin chromaticity matrices directly within canvas filters.

challenges.title: Database Query Speed for Nearest Neighbor Matching
challenges.challenge: Calculating distance between a user's uploaded color and 15,000+ database records was causing high CPU usage.
challenges.solution: Implemented cube-based 3D spatial indexing in PostgreSQL, narrowing candidate matches within a tight bounding cube before computing Euclidean distances.
